detail:
YOUNG stage of Chaspiral, between the original child and the adult imperial knight. A living asymmetric PAPER FENCING-DANCER CREATURE, not a human teenager cosplaying. Body about FOUR-AND-A-HALF heads tall, longer S-curved paper torso than child, clearly two small articulated arms with hands, two tapered folded-paper legs ending in modest wedge feet. Big head relative to adult but smaller than child's, slender neck. Ivory angular feminine creature face with almond teal manga eyes visible, alert mischievous grin (not seductive), firm cheek planes, coral spiral paper locks TWO different-sized coils not many repetitive curls. Ivory/turquoise SHORT tilted cup-derived cranial shell with little handle loop at back and a half crescent brow, NOT adult full gold crown, NO visor hiding eyes. Right shoulder small paper guard, other flexible, ivory/plum joint folds exposed so gesture clear. No full adult armor.
TWO asymmetric original wings now sweep behind torso as a half-mantle: near side large turquoise/petrol angular tension-paper sail with bamboo outer spar, far side shorter coral folded sail with ONE broad spiral. Clear roots behind shoulders, TWO wings not extra arms. Front body uses one long coral diamond fold flanked by turquoise hip folds as anatomy, no literal tuxedo/clothes/skirt suit. One hand holds a short gold SPOON-WAND now extended into a small practice fencing baton with one spiral guard, NOT full lethal adult rapier, not double weapons. Other hand extended like a conductor counting the next beat. Dynamic grounded light lunge, a touch offbeat, playful stage apprentice becoming precise. Complete soul-rabiola is a single continuous petrol cord with TWO diamond label tabs ivory/coral and ONE small gold BELL at end. Keep bright coral/turquoise/ivory dominance; plum only joint shadow. Do not make baby, adult knight miniature, fairy princess, witch, huge top hat, cards, clocks or gears. The asymmetrical mantle and growing measured gesture tell the intermediate story.
